testimonials.name: Jon Lloyd
testimonials.comment: Since Kevin Iu has helped develop the Bracknell Chess Club website over the last two years, our website has grown in to a well - organised, dynamic and interactive  space for keeping members informed and entertained. Our membership has increased by more than double over this period, which, in no small part, reflects the excellent work carried out by Kevin. We are delighted by everything that Kevin has done to help us grow our club
